title: Does Crypto Sentiment Extremity Widen Estimated Spreads? Evidence Depends on the Specification
abstract: arXiv:2602.07018v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We examine whether extreme values of the Crypto Fear & Greed Index are associated with a daily high-low spread estimate for Bitcoin. The sample contains 2,896 BTC/USDT observations from February 2018 to January 2026. We find an unconditional extreme-minus-neutral gap of 61.99 basis points. After close-to-close realised-volatility-quintile demeaning it is 24.79 basis points, although none of the five separate quintile contrasts survives Holm correction. With quadratic realised-volatility and strictly lagged momentum controls, the HAC estimate is 11.81 basis points (95% CI [-2.31,25.93], p=.101). A fixed non-parametric stratification gives 20.44 basis points (p=.0195 under circular shifts), while separate models for a zero-floored estimate's incidence and positive magnitude are imprecise. translated_title: 加密货币情绪极端化会扩大估计的价差吗？证据取决于模型设定
translated_abstract: 我们研究了加密货币恐惧与贪婪指数的极端值是否与比特币的日高低价差估计相关。样本包含2018年2月至2026年1月期间的2,896个BTC/USDT观测值。我们发现，在无条件情形下，极端情绪与中性情绪之间的价差缺口为61.99个基点。在经过基于收盘价至收盘价已实现波动率的五分位去均值处理后，该缺口为24.79个基点，但五个单独的五分位组间对比均未能通过Holm校正。在加入二次形式的已实现波动率以及严格滞后的动量控制变量后，HAC估计值为11.81个基点（95%置信区间为[-2.31, 25.93]，p=.101）。采用固定的非参数分层方法得到20.44个基点的结果（在循环位移检验下p=.0195），而针对零下限估计的发生概率与正幅度分别建模的结果则不够精确。因此，研究结果显示的仅是一种描述性的、依赖于模型设定的关联。我们得出的结论是，这些结果并不能证明存在稳定或因果性的流动性（关系）。
tldr: 该研究发现加密货币恐惧与贪婪指数的极端值与比特币价差扩大之间仅存在一种依赖于模型设定的描述性关联，不足以证明稳定或因果性的流动性效应。
en_tdlr: The study finds only a descriptive, specification-dependent association between extreme Crypto Fear & Greed Index values and wider Bitcoin spread estimates, which does not establish a stable or causal liquidity effect.
